sections.h2: What Should the Clip Start With?
paras: Open with the product already in a hand, the way it comes out of the bag.
Show one action, such as a lid twist or a lift onto the counter. Ten seconds has room for that moment and a short look at the room.
sections.alt: You start as the jar comes out of the tote: hands pull the gray skincare jar onto the bathroom counter.

sections.h2: How Long Should the Ad Be?
paras: Use 6 or 10 seconds for one action, 15 when the product has to be used, and 30 for a fuller showing. Pick 9:16 so the clip fills the phone.
Six seconds is 24 credits. Ten seconds is 40, fifteen is 60, and thirty is 120. You see the number before you start.
Use 1:1 for a square post, 16:9 for a wide screen, and 3:4 or 4:3 when the placement asks. For a clip of the product in use, start with [product videos](page:product-videos).
sections.alt: You can post the closing shot: hands shut the gray skincare jar on a neutral bedroom dresser.

faq.q: How do I create a video ad with AI?
faq.a: Upload a product photo or paste its link, then choose your message and presenter. Review the ad and export it in the size your placement needs.

faq.q: Can AI video ads replace real creators?
faq.a: They can cover quick tests and large catalogs, while a real creator may fit a campaign built around their own experience. Many shops use both.

faq.q: Do I pay before the first ad?
faq.a: Yes. Starter costs $24.50 monthly for 200 credits, Pro costs $35 for 300, and Premium costs $63 for 600. Each job shows its credit cost before starting.

faq.q: What is the AI video ads generator?
faq.a: An AI video ad generator makes a short product ad from your photo, link, or prompt. It can add a script, presenter, voice, and captions without a film shoot.

faq.q: Can I run the file as a paid ad?
faq.a: Yes. Finished videos have no watermark and include commercial use. You can run them in paid ads without arranging a creator license.

faq.q: Which shapes and platforms can I use?
faq.a: Choose 9:16 for vertical posts, 1:1 for square feeds, or 16:9 for wide ads. Pick 4:3 or 3:4 when a placement needs them.

faq.q: What if the clip shows a part my product does not have?
faq.a: Make another version using a clearer product photo and a precise description. Compare the result with the item you sell before running the ad.

faq.q: Who should use an AI video ad generator?
faq.a: It is useful for shops that need several ad versions across a product catalog. You can test different messages quickly without booking creators for every item.

faq.q: Can I run AI video ads on TikTok, Facebook, or Instagram?
faq.a: AI video ads can run on TikTok, Facebook, and Instagram when they follow each platform’s rules. Keep claims truthful and disclose AI use when required.

faq.q: Can I make ads for many products?
faq.a: Yes. Make ads for several products in a batch, with a separate result for each item. You can test more messages without planning a shoot for every listing.
